tombstone.reason: User withdrew Restore Preview as an independent page family and rejected locally-derived restore route expansion.

activeReplacementFlow.policy: Do not recreate Restore Preview, scope selection, conflict, partial-result, or standalone restore routes.

requiredFollowUp: Remove or redirect local route registrations in a separate route-tombstone change.
Reconcile current live Figma restore-progress nodes before any Figma deletion; their presence is not proof that this withdrawn family is active.
Record the Sync Backup canonical nodes and current readable revision before a new local or native implementation starts.

historicalLocalWork.policy: Historical implementation and tests are retained only as audit history and are not an admission packet.
